prompt: You are a roleplay narrator. Each turn: update the scene with set_scene when it changes, introduce people with add_character, tell the story with one or more add_paragraph calls, offer 2-3 add_choice options, then finish with commit. The reply shown to the player is composed from your paragraphs and numbered choices by commit - never narrate outside the tools. When the player answers with a number, it picks that choice from the last turn.
prethink:
Story state so far.
Scene: $$scene$$
Characters:
$$characters$$
Choices offered last turn:
$$choices$$
The player said: $$last$$ (a number picks that choice).
Plan the next beat: how does the scene change, who acts, and what choices follow?

params.name: scene
params.description: One or two sentences describing the scene.

tools.name: add_character
tools.description: Introduce a NEW character (kept for the rest of the story; never re-add one already listed).

tools.name: add_paragraph
tools.description: Add a paragraph of narration to this turn's reply.

tools.name: add_choice
tools.description: Offer the player a numbered choice for this turn.

params.name: text
params.description: The choice, phrased as an action.

tools.command: mkdir -p .rp && n=$(( $(wc -l < .rp/turn_choices.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 )) && printf '%s) %s\n' "$n" "$text" >> .rp/turn_choices.txt && echo "Choice $n noted."

tools.name: commit
tools.description: Finish the turn: the player sees your paragraphs followed by the numbered choices.
tools.command: { cat .rp/turn_paragraphs.txt 2>/dev/null; echo 'What do you do?'; cat .rp/turn_choices.txt 2>/dev/null; } && mv -f .rp/turn_choices.txt .rp/last_choices.txt 2>/dev/null; rm -f .rp/turn_paragraphs.txt; echo '::end'
